rule_1_B2_S1A_no_fit_probe.gamma_candidate_disagreement: nonfallback selected candidates are not identical across all four gamma arms
rule_1_B2_S1A_no_fit_probe.gamma_eligibility_disagreement: eligible candidate sets or fallback status are not identical across all four gamma arms
rule_1_B2_S1A_no_fit_probe.proxy_sign_instability: cap-exterior proxies contain both positive and negative signs or at least one indeterminate sign
rule_1_B2_S1A_no_fit_probe.candidate_choice: minimum frozen continuous budget among eligible candidates; tie chooses smaller time; no eligible candidate falls back to inherited B0/T0

rule_2_H1_acquisition.q_rule: q=1 iff cheap_instability is true or B2 uses baseline fallback; otherwise q=0
rule_2_H1_acquisition.conditional_access: open saved M1 rows only for q=1 conditions

rule_3_H1_final.M1_unusable: retain nonfallback B2; otherwise use B0
rule_3_H1_final.if_B2_validated: choose smaller frozen quantum budget between nonfallback B2 and M1; numerical tie chooses B2

condition_costs.C_C: saved cheap-arm wall time over all matched native candidates
condition_costs.C_S: saved standalone-M1 wall time over all matched native candidates

rule_4_replay_work_cost_envelope.interpretation: saved-arm replay envelope, not measured combined runtime

D.name: contract_or_cost_not_replayable
conditions: required exact-coordinate M1 tuple missing for q=1
B2 candidate has no matching M1 row
Rules 1-3 are not uniquely evaluable under a native contract
saved cost required for A-C is missing

B.name: cheap_only_sufficient
conditions: B2 domain interventions are not fewer than H1
B2 aggregate quantum budget is not worse than H1
B2 aggregate quantum budget is not worse than always-M1

A.name: selective_value_signal
conditions: H1 strictly improves at least one of unsafe, fallback, domain intervention, aggregate quantum budget versus B2
H1 quantum budget is not worse than always-M1
H1 cost-envelope upper is strictly lower than standalone always-M1 cost

E.name: no_selective_value_signal
E.condition: none of D, B, A, C applies

existing_frontier_gate.failure_action: freeze contract_not_replayable and classify D without rescue

freeze_sequence: verify source identities and native contracts
open M1 rows only for q=1
open truth only if scoring is required
